title: 第十章  老板娘—唐半月
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

——半月居饭店包间

叶落和沈苍月坐在对面，突然沈苍月目光一凝，嘴角微扬，

“倒是有几只不怕死的爬虫。”

“什么？”叶落疑惑，他虽然肉身实力强大，但是尚且还是炼体境界，还没有达到灵识外放的程度，所以自然也就不知道门外已经聚集了一帮人。

“呯！”包间的门被一脚踹开。

为首一人正是那个小李，

“小子，我们家少爷看上你的马子了”，“你要是识相的话，就赶紧滚！”他对着叶落大喊大叫，

叶落看了看他，又看了看面无表情的沈苍月，“你是说她？你们少爷人呢，让他到这儿来。”

叶落也没想麻烦饭店里的人，毕竟他在这谁也不认识，但饭店里的服务员却一点也不含糊，

”哪来的小混混，竟然敢在我半月居闹事，活腻了吗“，话虽如此，但餐厅里的服务员却都是一些未修炼的女子，

而小李见已经闹到这个地步，老板娘还不出现，想必今日不在此处，心里的慌乱少了一些，于是抬手就要扇那服务员的耳光。

就在叶落要出手的刹那，整个半月居上空的天突然暗了下来，

“找死！”一个清脆却又透着狠辣的声音从天上传来，惶惶威压如同天塌地陷般，

与此同时，在远处的谢大伟等一干人等和包间里的闯入者瞬间化为血雾，

“我半月居何人敢入侵？！”

“好强大的力量啊”叶落眼睛一亮，“月姐，你是什么境界？”

“我？我当然没有，我就是一个小小的大学班主任，不过区区半步玄空境界罢了，这个半月居的老板娘可是天域级强者，据说比我们校长还要牛呢？”

“怪不得，天域境界，”叶落露出一丝苦笑，自己现在才是炼体境界，自己给古老头的承诺是两年之内进入青龙殿，而进入青龙殿的第一个要求就是达到临渊境。

“嗯？青龙殿？等等，难道和青龙诀有什么关系？”叶落决定回去后好好研究，自己缺失的记忆说不定也与之有关。

“小女唐半月，两位是世纪大学的人吗？刚刚是小女监管不力，希望不要责怪奴家啊”门外缓缓走来一个身穿古装的女子。

叶落行了一礼，他自然明白了面前这位就是半月居的老板娘，这个老板娘可不是什么花瓶，叶落可不想因为自己的行为而触犯她。

“老板娘说笑了，所谓虫子年年有，今年特别多，不过就是几个臭虫，本来有我出手就行了。”

唐半月眼波流转，“那几个人到底也有聚灵小成的境界，看来小弟弟对自己的实力很自信啊。”

“有没有实力就不捞老板娘操心了，叶落是我的学生，自然由我守护好。”一旁一直面无表情的沈苍月说话了。

“既然沈老师这么说，倒是我唐突了，来人，把至尊卡赠予二位。”

一旁的叶落分明看到唐半月眼底闪过一丝慌乱，但也没有多想。沈苍月倒是没有推辞，直接把至尊卡拿了过来。

叶落跟着沈苍月来到另外一个包间继续吃饭，他们本来就是为了吃饭而来，自然要吃完再回去。

——半月居顶层

一个服务员跪在那里瑟瑟发抖，

“算了，起来吧，今天的事情也不怪你们，本来也是小事，可惜他们惹到了不该惹的人”，

“小赵，把谢家给我灭了，马上。”

看似空无一人的一旁，“谢家背后可是.........”

——Private room of Banyueju Hotel

Ye Luo and Shen Cangyue were sitting across from each other. Suddenly, Shen Cangyue's eyes narrowed and the corners of her mouth raised slightly.

"There are a few reptiles that are not afraid of death."

"What?" Ye Luo was confused. Although his physical strength was strong, he was still in the realm of body refining and had not yet reached the level of releasing his spiritual consciousness, so naturally he didn't know that a group of people had gathered outside the door.

"Bang!" The door to the private room was kicked open.

The leader is none other than Xiao Li.

"Boy, our young master has fallen in love with you." "If you have any sense, get out of here!" He yelled at Ye Luo,

Ye Luo looked at him, then at the expressionless Shen Cangyue, "You mean her? Where is your young master? Let him come here."

Ye Luo didn't want to bother the people in the hotel. After all, he didn't know anyone here, but the waiter in the hotel was unambiguous at all.

"What kind of little gangster dared to cause trouble in my Banyue residence? Are you tired of living?" Even so, the waiters in the restaurant are all untrained women.

When Xiao Li saw that the commotion had reached this point and the landlady hadn't appeared yet, she must not be here today, he felt less panic, so he raised his hand to slap the waiter in the face.

Just when Ye Luo was about to take action, the sky above the entire Ban Yue Ju suddenly turned dark.

"Looking for death!" A crisp but cruel voice came from the sky, panic and pressure, as if the sky was falling and the earth was falling.

At the same time, Xie Dawei and others in the distance and the intruder in the private room instantly turned into blood mist,

"Who dares to invade my Banyue Home?!"

"What a powerful force." Ye Luo's eyes lit up, "Sister Yue, what state are you in?"

"Me? Of course I don't. I am just a small university class teacher, only half a step into the Xuan Kong realm. This Ban Yueju boss lady is a Tianyu level powerhouse. It is said that she is even better than our principal?"

"No wonder, the realm of heaven," Ye Luo showed a wry smile. He was now in the realm of body refining. His promise to the ancient leader was to enter the Qinglong Palace within two years, and the first requirement for entering the Qinglong Palace was to reach the Abyssal Realm.

"Huh? Qinglong Palace? Wait, does it have anything to do with Qinglong Jue?" Ye Luo decided to study it carefully after going back. His missing memory might also be related to it.

"My daughter, Tang Banyue, are you two from Century University? My daughter was not supervised well just now. I hope you don't blame the slave family." A woman in ancient costume walked slowly outside the door.

Ye Luo saluted, and he naturally understood that the person in front of him was the proprietress of Banyueju. This proprietress was not a flower vase, and Ye Luo did not want to offend her because of his behavior.

"The boss lady was joking. There are so-called bugs every year, but there are so many this year. They are just a few bedbugs. It would have been fine if I took action."

Tang Banyue's eyes flashed, "Those people have reached the level of gathering spirits after all. It seems that the younger brother is very confident in his own strength."

"Don't worry about the boss lady whether you have the strength or not. Ye Luo is my student, so naturally I will protect him." Shen Cangyue, who had been expressionless at the side, spoke.

"Since Teacher Shen said so, I am being rude. Come here and give the Supreme Card to both of you."

Ye Luo on the side clearly saw a flash of panic in Tang Banyue's eyes, but didn't think much about it.Shen Cangyue didn't refuse and took the Supreme Card directly.

Ye Luo followed Shen Cangyue to another private room to continue eating. They came here just to eat, so naturally they had to finish before going back.

——Half Moon is on the top floor

A waiter knelt there shivering,

"Forget it, get up. I don't blame you for what happened today. It was a trivial matter in the first place, but it's a pity that they offended someone they shouldn't have."

"Xiao Zhao, destroy the Xie family for me, right now."

There seemed to be no one on the side, "Behind the Xie family..."
